title: Dimensions.
officialText:
Micropiles shall have an outside diameter of between 5 and 14 inches (127 and 356 mm). The minimum
diameter set forth elsewhere in Section 1810.3.5 shall not apply to micropiles. The steel pipe shall have a minimum wall thickness
of 3/ inch (4.8 mm).
16
